description: Slow-braised lamb with warm spices, tender and deeply aromatic, layered with sweetness and richness in every bite.
A layered pastry enjoyed both sweet and savory, here featuring a spiced beef filling, crisp, rich and filling.
Tender lamb served over rice and soaked in a warm, tangy yogurt sauce, rich, fragrant, and meant to be shared.
Lamb layered over aromatic rice, infused with warm spices and a subtle smokiness.
A warm, comforting soup offered in several variations, from red lentil to chicken or beef, simple, nourishing, and deeply familiar.
Pita bread stuffed with sujok, tomato and cheese.
